metaData.originalTitle: 面壁智能端侧双响开源：MiniCPM5-1B 以 1B 打败 2B，BitCPM-CANN 释放 6 倍显存红利
metaData.title: Face Intelligence Open-Sources Two Edge-Side Models: MiniCPM5-1B Beats 2B with 1B Parameters, BitCPM-CANN Unlocks 6x VRAM Efficiency
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Face Intelligence, in collaboration with Tsinghua University, open-sources MiniCPM5-1B and BitCPM-CANN. The former surpasses 2B-level models with just 1B parameters, while the latter achieves 6x VRAM efficiency through 1.58-bit quantization, marking a breakthrough in domestic computing power based on the full Huawei Ascend stack.
metaData.summary: Face Intelligence, in partnership with Tsinghua University and the OpenBMB open-source community, released two models during the Edge-Side Large Model Open Source Week. MiniCPM5-1B, with only 1B parameters, surpasses all models under 2B parameters (including Qwen3.5-2B) on the AA-Index. After INT4 quantization, its weights are only 0.5GB, enabling it to run on mobile phones, browsers, and even pure CPU environments. Its training data employs a tiered data governance system, and it open-sources the high-quality synthetic dataset Ultra-FineWeb-L3. BitCPM-CANN is a 1.58-bit ternary large model fully trained end-to-end on the Huawei Ascend platform, available in four sizes: 0.5B, 1B, 3B, and 8B. Compared to BF16, it unlocks approximately 6x VRAM efficiency while retaining 90%-97.2% of its capabilities. The article also details model deployment and fine-tuning methods, highlighting that the ForgeTrain framework was entirely written by AI, validating the feasibility of AI manufacturing AI.

mainPoints.point: MiniCPM5-1B surpasses all models under 2B parameters on the AA-Index with just 1B parameters, setting a new record for intelligence density.
mainPoints.explanation: Through tiered data governance and high-quality synthetic data, this model demonstrates that small models can achieve higher intelligence density with careful training, validating the Density Law that intelligence density doubles every 3.5 months.

mainPoints.point: BitCPM-CANN adopts 1.58-bit quantization-aware training, unlocking approximately 6x VRAM efficiency while retaining over 90% of its capabilities.
mainPoints.explanation: Unlike post-training quantization, BitCPM-CANN learns to represent knowledge with ternary weights from the initial training stage, fundamentally improving information density. This allows an 8B model to run smoothly on flagship smartphones.

mainPoints.point: BitCPM-CANN is fully trained end-to-end on the Huawei Ascend platform, overcoming the challenge of extreme low-bit training on domestic computing power.
mainPoints.explanation: From quantization operators to the training framework, the entire pipeline is natively completed on Ascend, filling the gap in low-bit model supply for domestic NPUs. It proves that Ascend can not only train large models but also achieve world-class extreme low-bit training.

mainPoints.point: The ForgeTrain training framework was entirely written by AI, validating the recursive self-improvement path of AI manufacturing AI.
mainPoints.explanation: ForgeTrain's training speed on H100 surpasses NVIDIA's Megatron framework by 10%. Its success demonstrates the feasibility of AI autonomously writing production-grade code and achieving leading results.

keyQuotes: MiniCPM5-1B once again pushes the upper limit of model intelligence density: with only 1B parameters, it surpasses all models under 2B parameters on the AA-Index.

BitCPM-CANN adopts the quantization-aware training (QAT) approach... allowing the model to 'grow natively' under the constraints of extremely low bit-width, forcing every bit to maximize information density and knowledge carrying efficiency.
This is the first publicly available result on the Ascend platform to complete end-to-end 1.58-bit training and conduct full-precision comparative evaluations.
It's not about waiting for hardware to become stronger to adapt to the model, but about making the model smarter to adapt to the hardware.

relatedArticles.title: MemPrivacy Open-Source: Let Cloud-Edge Agents Remember You Without Handing Over Your Privacy
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: The MemPrivacy open-source project proposes a local reversible pseudonymization scheme that allows cloud-edge agents to protect privacy while almost entirely preserving reasoning and memory capabilities.

relatedArticles.title: Hunyuan Embodied-0.5 Open Source: Designed for Real-World Embodied Agents, a New Foundation for Physical Agents
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent's Hunyuan team has open-sourced the HY-Embodied-0.5 model series, which significantly enhances edge-side model capabilities in 3D spatial perception and physical planning through a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture and large-scale embodied data.

relatedArticles.title: Transcript: The Confidence and Vision of China's AI Open Source
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Led by Academician Wang Huaimin, top experts discuss the shift of China's AI open source from 'following' to 'leading', and the vision of building a new 'Open Resource' ecosystem leveraging manufacturing and application scenario advantages.

relatedArticles.title: Xiaohongshu Open-Sources FireRed-OCR: 2B Parameter Model Tops Document Parsing Leaderboard
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Xiaohongshu has open-sourced the 2B-parameter FireRed-OCR model, which achieves performance surpassing ultra-large-scale general models in document parsing through innovative three-stage training and format-constrained reinforcement learning.

relatedArticles.title: Alibaba Tongyi Lab Open-Sources Mobile-Agent-v3.5: A Truly "Multi-Platform Ready" Native GUI Agent Foundation Model
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Alibaba Tongyi Lab has open-sourced the Mobile-Agent-v3.5 and GUI-Owl-1.5 model families, building a unified native GUI Agent foundation across multiple platforms through hybrid data flywheels and multi-platform reinforcement learning.
